Tara: Heads up — staging CI perf regression after merge of kernel-selector hysteresis (PR #4123). 95th latency up ~22% on the 512-token bench. CI attached some perf logs, looks reproducible locally.

deploy-bot: [ci] perf-check failed on staging-run-2026-04-10. Regression detected: 95p +22%, median +5%. Job: perf/staging/kernels. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/9853

Mike: @Tara I can bisect now. If it's the hysteresis change we should try toggling the heuristic flag first. Starting with: `git bisect start HEAD v1.9.1 -- python3 tools/perf_check.py --profile=512`

Olivia: FWIW I peeked at a couple of the perf traces earlier and there was a KV-cache thrash pattern. Might be the selector ping-ponging kernels and causing prefix/KV churn. Short flame snippet: ```flamegraph: kv::refresh -> selector::choose_kernel -> kv::evict -> memcpy```

Sam: If bisect points to the selector change, plan: 1) bisect and confirm 2) open revert PR on main + cherry-pick to release-1.9 3) run full perf-suite + smoke + canary 4) coordinate canary pool with infra. I'll draft a revert template so we can move fast.

Mike: Bisect finished — culprit commit 7f2a9c0 (selector: hysteresis default on). Reproduces locally with `./bench/run_latency.py --tokens 512 --trials 10`. Revert PR incoming: `git revert 7f2a9c0 -m 1` then `./scripts/run_perf_suite --profile=512 --runs=5` to verify.

Tara: Good catch. @Sam after PR merges please queue a canary rollout and run the staged perf-run against the canary pool. Also add a quick regression test to the perf harness that asserts KV eviction rate <10% over 1M tokens to catch this earlier.

Sam: Will do — drafting the revert + backport PRs now and adding the perf assertion. @Olivia can you re-check flamegraphs after the revert and paste them here? :thumbsup:
